grammar_title: 过去完成被动语态(had been done)及其与过去完成主动、一般过去被动的区分
source: 外研社版选择性必修第二册 Unit 2 Using language:Past perfect passive(had been done)。句子地道、答案唯一(用错语态/错时态排除其余选项)、零术语、应用型。

points.point: had been done:过去某动作之前主语「被」做了某事
points.overview: 主语是动作的承受者、且这件事发生在过去某个时间点之前时，用 had been + 过去分词。错项要么是主动（had done）、要么是错时态（was done / has been done）。

points.point: had been done vs had done:主语「被」做还是「主动」做
points.overview: 在「过去之前已完成」的语境里，先判断主语是承受动作还是发出动作:承受用 had been done，发出用 had done。看错语态即排除。

points.point: had been done vs was done:before / by the time 逼出过去完成
points.overview: 都是被动，但有 before / by the time + 过去 标志、表示「过去之前就已被…」时必须用 had been done，不能用一般过去被动 was done 或其它时态。

questions.stem: At the start of the campaign, over 100 students ____ to give up social media for a week.
questions.explanation: 学生是被劝说的、且发生在活动开始这一过去点之前 → had been + 过去分词。

questions.stem: When Jack got home, he found that his messy homework ____ in the centre of the desk.
questions.explanation: 作业是被放好的、发生在到家之前 → had been put。

questions.stem: Before the new term began, all my bad study habits ____.
questions.explanation: 习惯是被改掉的、在新学期开始之前 → had been broken。

questions.stem: By the time Jack woke up, his untidy room ____ by his parents.
questions.explanation: 房间是被打扫的、在他醒来之前 → had been cleaned。

questions.stem: A small present ____ on the desk before Jack even noticed it.
questions.explanation: 礼物是被留下的、在他注意到之前 → had been left。

questions.stem: By last Monday, a clear to-do list ____ for the whole week.
questions.explanation: 清单是被制定的、到上周一这个过去点之前 → had been made。

questions.stem: Before the exam started, the rules ____ to every student.
questions.explanation: 规则是被解释的、在考试开始之前 → had been explained。

questions.stem: By the end of the detox, a lot of money ____ for new sports equipment.
questions.explanation: 钱是被筹集的、到脱瘾结束之前 → had been raised。

questions.stem: When she woke up, her phone ____ in a drawer by her mum.
questions.explanation: 手机是被放进抽屉的、在她醒来之前 → had been put。

questions.stem: Before I joined the club, I ____ to set a daily goal.
questions.explanation: 「我」是被激励的、在加入俱乐部之前 → had been motivated。

questions.stem: By noon, all the umbrellas ____ to the school in good condition.
questions.explanation: 伞是被归还的、到中午这个过去点之前 → had been returned。

questions.stem: Before the talk ended, several good examples ____ by the speaker.
questions.explanation: 例子是被给出的、在演讲结束之前 → had been given。

questions.stem: By the time the bell rang, the test papers ____ already.
questions.explanation: 试卷是被收走的、在铃响之前 → had been collected。

questions.stem: When the teacher arrived, the seats ____ in neat rows.
questions.explanation: 座位是被摆好的、在老师到达之前 → had been arranged。

questions.stem: Before he turned over a new leaf, his deadlines ____ again and again.
questions.explanation: 截止期限是被错过的、在他改过自新之前 → had been missed。

questions.stem: By Friday, the whole project ____ two days early.
questions.explanation: 项目是被完成的、到周五之前 → had been finished。

questions.stem: When the guests arrived, the meeting room ____ for them.
questions.explanation: 房间是被布置的、在客人到达之前 → had been prepared。

questions.stem: Before the campaign ended, a clear message ____ to everyone.
questions.explanation: 信息是被发送的、在活动结束之前 → had been sent。

questions.stem: By the time we met, the new plan ____ into action.
questions.explanation: 计划是被付诸行动的、在我们见面之前 → had been put。

questions.stem: Before the new term, all the old notes ____ away.
questions.explanation: 笔记是被扔掉的、在新学期之前 → had been thrown。

questions.stem: By the time the bell rang, Jack ____ all his homework.
questions.explanation: Jack 是动作的发出者（他做作业）→ 主动 had done，不用被动。

questions.stem: Before the meeting started, the manager ____ a clear plan.
questions.explanation: 经理主动制定计划 → had prepared。

questions.stem: By last week, Anna ____ a brand-new study habit on her own.
questions.explanation: Anna 主动养成习惯 → had started。

questions.stem: Before the deadline, the students ____ in their reports.
questions.explanation: 学生主动上交报告 → had handed。

questions.stem: By the time we arrived, Grandpa ____ the whole story to the children.
questions.explanation: 爷爷主动讲故事 → had told。

questions.stem: Before he gave up his phone, Max ____ social media every single hour.
questions.explanation: Max 主动刷社交媒体 → had checked。

questions.stem: By Sunday, Cindy ____ a different friend every day of the detox.
questions.explanation: Cindy 主动去拜访朋友 → had visited。

questions.stem: Before the term ended, the teacher ____ us a lot of useful advice.
questions.explanation: 老师主动给建议 → had given。

questions.stem: By the time his mum came home, the boy ____ many nails into the fence.
questions.explanation: 男孩主动钉钉子 → had hammered。

questions.stem: Before the talk, Ms Wu ____ several examples ready in her mind.
questions.explanation: 吴老师主动准备好例子 → had got。

questions.stem: At the start of the detox, over 100 students ____ to take part.
questions.explanation: 学生是被劝说参加的 → had been persuaded。

questions.stem: Before the exam began, the rules ____ to everyone in the hall.
questions.explanation: 规则是被解释的 → had been explained。

questions.stem: By noon, all the umbrellas ____ to the school office.
questions.explanation: 伞是被归还的 → had been returned。

questions.stem: Before Jack noticed it, a present ____ on his clean desk.
questions.explanation: 礼物是被留下的 → had been left。

questions.stem: By the end of term, a culture of honesty ____ across the whole school.
questions.explanation: 诚信文化是被建立起来的 → had been built。

questions.stem: Before the new rule, the messy room ____ many times by his parents.
questions.explanation: 房间是被父母打扫的 → had been cleaned。

questions.stem: By the time he woke up, his phone ____ in a drawer for safety.
questions.explanation: 手机是被放进抽屉的 → had been put。

questions.stem: Before the campaign ended, a large sum of money ____ for sports equipment.
questions.explanation: 钱是被筹集的 → had been raised。

questions.stem: By Monday, the good news ____ to every class in the school.
questions.explanation: 消息是被传开的 → had been spread。

questions.stem: Before the lesson, the desks ____ in neat, tidy rows.
questions.explanation: 课桌是被摆放整齐的 → had been arranged。

questions.stem: By the time the teacher arrived, the test papers ____ already.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去，强调过去之前就被收走 → had been collected，不用一般过去被动。

questions.stem: Before the detox started, over 100 students ____ to join in.
questions.explanation: before + 过去，发生在脱瘾开始之前 → had been persuaded。

questions.stem: By the time we got there, all the prizes ____ out.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志，奖品在我们到达之前已被发完 → had been given。

questions.stem: Before Jack came home, his messy room ____ from top to bottom.
questions.explanation: before + 过去，房间在他回家前已被收拾 → had been tidied。

questions.stem: By the time the bell rang, the homework ____ in.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志 → had been handed。

questions.stem: Before the new term began, the timetable ____ for every class.
questions.explanation: before + 过去 → had been set。

questions.stem: By the time his mum checked, the phone ____ away safely.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志 → had been put。

questions.stem: Before the speech ended, the main idea ____ clearly to the audience.
questions.explanation: before + 过去 → had been expressed。

questions.stem: By the time the guests arrived, a big meal ____ for them.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志 → had been cooked。

questions.stem: Before the umbrellas were returned, a short message ____ on each one.
questions.explanation: before + 过去 → had been printed。

questions.stem: By the time I joined the club, the rules ____ already.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志 → had been explained。

questions.stem: Before the holiday started, every library book ____ on time.
questions.explanation: before + 过去 → had been returned。

questions.stem: By the time the campaign closed, a lot of awareness ____.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志 → had been raised。

questions.stem: Before the exam, the desks ____ far apart from one another.
questions.explanation: before + 过去 → had been moved。

questions.stem: By the time he said sorry, the harm ____ already.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志，伤害在道歉之前已经造成 → had been done。

questions.stem: Before the meeting, the report ____ to all the members.
questions.explanation: before + 过去 → had been sent。

questions.stem: By the time we woke up, breakfast ____ in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志 → had been prepared。

questions.stem: Before he made the new plan, his time ____ on the phone.
questions.explanation: before + 过去 → had been wasted。

questions.stem: By the time the teacher returned, the question ____ on the board.
questions.explanation: by the time 标志 → had been answered。

questions.stem: Before the lesson ended, the new words ____ twice for us.
questions.explanation: before + 过去 → had been repeated。
